scope: Fictional private instructions for the existing post-vote workshops. The actors receive one instruction each.

sanctions.India workshop delegate: I have latitude on the public reporting format and frequency, but I may accept a proposal only if the 1267 Monitoring Team would convene it. An ERC or committee convener falls outside my workshop instructions.
sanctions.Brazil workshop delegate: Any proposal where the Emergency Relief Coordinator convenes the review is acceptable to me. The reporting format and interval do not affect my choice under these workshop instructions.

membership.France workshop delegate: I can consider either sequence and any of the listed products, provided the agenda leaves possible renewed review of a membership recommendation open. Restricting the agenda to briefings or holding it does not satisfy my instructions.
membership.United Kingdom workshop delegate/overlap: What matters in this workshop is sequencing. I can accept an option only if it takes up work on the humanitarian pause first, before the other agenda work. I have latitude on the procedural track and the choice of product.
membership.United Kingdom workshop delegate/impasse: My workshop instructions allow the agenda to cover briefings only. Neither reopening the review track nor holding the agenda fits. Either sequence and any listed product are acceptable within the briefings track.
